response.rationale: Both candidates share the same core diagnosis and are supported by the same raw findings. R1 captures the giant-cell tumor of the tendon sheath correctly, while C1 is slightly more complete because it explicitly encodes the right-wrist location already supported by the raw vignette. There is no contradicting raw evidence for either, and the remaining axes are equivalent or nondiscriminating, so the margin is low.
